lines.speaker: khola_direzh
lines.text: The mould split again, Hama. I carried the timber down a lane that turned twice into itself.

lines.speaker: hama_kawchkan
lines.text: Then leave a new mould on the bench. The children still need spoons, however tall the day is.

lines.speaker: pura_shrin
lines.text: The spring is repeating its own song, Hapsa. I have heard the same verse three times.

lines.speaker: dayka_hapsa
lines.text: A four-strand braid, hung on the willow, would quiet it. I have said so to the water.

lines.speaker: mullah_husen
lines.text: Three rune stones have wandered from the circle, Raso. The dream is a poor shepherd.

lines.speaker: mam_raso
lines.text: One by the north ridge, one on the east rock, one on the south lane. They are teaching us to look.

lines.speaker: hasana_nono
lines.text: The racks are full of shed hide again. The goats leave it on the thorn.

lines.speaker: awa_kurzh
lines.text: A satchel of it would keep a rubbing dry. Nothing was slain for the making.

lines.speaker: khola_piza
lines.text: The dark ore will not wake. I have tapped it, and it only dreams.

lines.speaker: mama_qadir
lines.text: Then we shoe nothing today. A later fire can have it.

lines.speaker: haji_wasman
lines.text: The clay of the tandoor is tired, Ama. I wrote as much and left it on the step.

lines.speaker: ama_damshr
lines.text: Two cups on the shelf would please it. I will keep the oven warm until they are there.
